entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Skip analyzers on command line when their diagnostics would not be visible in the build #81031
  • Generator telemetry should include timings for each table transform #81027
  • Feature Request: Allow Filtering Analyzer Execution by Severity During Build #81026
  • Target-typed switch expression doesn't handle typing well #81022
  • Target-typed conditional expression doesn't handle typing well #81021
  • Unexpected quick info type display when `dynamic` is involved #81020
  • Evaluate disabling Tiered Compilation in Roslyn ServiceHub process #81016
  • VS2026 11116.177 ignores fade out unused members settings #81012
  • VS editor adding invalid spaces #81011
  • Extensions members aren't shown correctly in Visual Studio 2026 #81010
  • Missing "Show only Extension Properties" option #81009

Closed

  • C# Interactive does not use .NET Core 8 SDK in Visual Studio 2022 #71434
    Backlog
  • Stackoverflow in `BindNonGenericSimpleNamespaceOrTypeOrAliasSymbol` in C# extension #80987
    18.3
  • "managed" and "unmanaged" keywords are not offered in cast expressions to function pointers after starting to type #81015
  • "Introduce parameter for" produces invalid code for nested anonymous type #81013
  • Base type for enums is neither properly autocompleted nor classified when declaration ends in semicolon #81007
  • IDE0028 (Collection initialization can be simplified) with CollectionBuilder methods results in recursive invocations #70099
    Backlog
  • Verify runtime execution of runtime async tests #79791
    18.3
  • "Extract Method" handles variables defined from pattern matching poorly #79489
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Delete unused installer package #81038
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Upgrade integration tests to vs2026 #81037
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Track the project name for a generator driver and report it via ETW #81036
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Source Generators, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Don't emit DebuggerStepThroughAttribute for runtime async methods #81035
  • Confirm and document analyzer skipping behavior for filtered severity levels #81032
  • [release/dev18.3] Try to reuse initialized generator drivers when we can #81030
  • Add timing telemetry for source generator table transform operations #81028
  • Target typed conditional expression recovery #81025
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Record anonymous type dependencies during initial binding #81024
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Razor EA changes to better support the dataTipRange LSP message in cohosting #81033
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update publish data for rel/d18.3 #81029
  • Try to reuse initialized generator drivers when we can #80845
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Enable LSP go-to-definition, find-all-references, and go-to-implementation with command handler precedence #80951
    Next
  • Add narrator support to move static members #81006
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Avoid broken NetCore1ESPool-Svc-Internal pool #81023
    Next
  • Avoid an infinite cycle in `MakeAcyclicBaseType` #81005
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix managed/unmanaged keyword completion after typing in function pointer contexts #81017
    VSCode, Next
  • Don't offer "Introduce parameter" on member initializer names #81014
    VSCode, Next
  • Enable runtime async tests #80362
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async, Next
  • Fix IDE0028: Suppress diagnostic in CollectionBuilder methods to prevent infinite recursion #81004
    VSCode, Next
  • Fix VariablesDeclaredWalker with recursive patterns #80910
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Update Azure pipeline queue names from vs2022 to vs2026 #80782
  • Fix returning valid pp symbol info on unrelated preprocessor directives #72910
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged, Backlog
  • Add ParameterListStructureProvider for collapsing multi-line parameter lists #80944
    VSCode
  • Use constant indices when populating Lists and arrays in collection expressions #80999
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Report an error for dynamic evaluation of `&&`/`||` when left operand is statically typed as an interface #80962
  • Fix await keyword recognition in interpolated strings with parentheses #80763
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve parser error recovery for property declarations with missing identifiers #81003
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • File-based programs live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #80859
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix cycle in partial event interface implementation #80994
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Partial Properties, Feature - Partial Events and Constructors
  • Avoid premature full binding of a receiver as a value in the process of binding possible type-or-value receiver (so-called “Color Color” scenario) #80978
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: improve diagnostics for operators #80928
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
